brand.name: RizPOS
brand.tagline: Sistem Point of Sale Modern, Cepat & Presisi
brand.persona: High-speed Multi-purpose POS for retail, F&B, cafes, and boutiques. Tactical, high-contrast, zero-friction workflow.

layout_and_spacing.grid_mode: High Density Grid (Mode B for Dashboards) + Tactile Touch Grid for Cashier
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-xl for cards & grid items, rounded-lg for buttons & inputs

cashier_layout.desktop: Grid 8 cols: Left 5 cols (Product catalog & filters) + Right 3 cols (Cart & Checkout drawer)
cashier_layout.tablet: Grid 2 cols or split screen with bottom cart summary trigger
cashier_layout.mobile: Single column product feed with bottom floating sticky Cart Bar (opens sheet drawer on tap)

responsive.layout: Mobile-first responsive layout. Sidebar collapses into touch drawer on mobile; Cashier cart slides out as full sheet on smaller screens.
responsive.typography: Mobile responsive typography scale with touch-friendly input targets (min 44px height for mobile buttons).
responsive.overflow_guard: overflow-x-hidden on root wrapper, table wrappers with overflow-x-auto, subgrid wrapping for cart items.
responsive.tap_targets: Minimum 44x44px for buttons, cart step adjusters (+/-), category selector pills, and fast cash payment buttons.

auth.page_style: Split layout with brand graphic on left (hero image/stats preview) + clean glassmorphic form card on right
auth.role_toggle: Tab or radio toggle for Admin vs Cashier quick switch with default demo credentials auto-fill button for fast evaluation

dashboard.metrics_cards: 4 high-impact metric cards (Today's Revenue, Transaction Count, Top Selling Category, Low Stock Warning) with micro trend indicators
dashboard.charts: Recharts / Shadcn Chart area/line graph for Daily Sales Trend + Donut chart for Category Revenue Split
dashboard.alerts: Low stock alert list with quick 'Restock' trigger action button

pos_cashier.search_bar: Search by product name or SKU + Barcode simulator button + Category pills
pos_cashier.product_card: Touch-friendly card with product thumbnail image, title, category badge, stock pill, price tag in IDR (Rp), and hover/active scale micro-interaction
pos_cashier.cart_drawer: Itemized list with quantity +/- buttons, discount selector (%), tax toggle (11% PPN), total breakdown, customer selector dropdown, and 'Process Payment' CTA
pos_cashier.payment_modal: Support Cash (with quick change counter & exact amount chips Rp50k, Rp100k), Card, QRIS (simulated QR code with countdown timer and instant success animation)
pos_cashier.digital_receipt: Print preview modal with store header, order ID, cashier name, customer info, itemized list, payment method, tax/discount breakdown, print action & download PDF simulation

management_modules.products: Data table with thumbnails, category color tags, stock status indicator, search/filter, and modal form with live preview
management_modules.categories: Grid of categories with icon pickers and item counter badges
management_modules.customers: Customer database with phone, total spent, loyalty points, and recent purchase popover
management_modules.transactions: Full transaction log with date range picker, payment status filter, view receipt modal, and export options
management_modules.reports: Sales reports by date, product, category with date range filter and export summary
management_modules.stock: Inventory management grid with quick stock adjustment (+ / -) modal and low-stock filter
management_modules.users: User management matrix for Admin only with role badge (Admin / Cashier) and status switch

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='pos-product-card-1', data-testid='cashier-checkout-button').
Use lucide-react or @heroicons/react for crisp UI icons.
Implement JWT auth state simulation stored in localStorage with default demo accounts (Admin: admin@rizpos.id / admin123; Cashier: cashier@rizpos.id / cashier123).
Currency formatting should default to Indonesian Rupiah (Rp X.XXX.XXX) with clean string formatting helper functions.
Include simulated QRIS payment modal featuring an animated QR code and payment completion state.
Include Digital Receipt modal with Print Preview (using CSS @media print or custom print frame overlay).
Maintain high-contrast readability with dark/light mode toggle support.
Mobile-first responsiveness: ensure sidebars collapse into sheet menu and cashier cart folds into a bottom bar on mobile screens.
